text:
sam (ae): Quick sync — AeroNexus wants POC next week but procurement insists on a notarized MSA + PO before any sandbox ingestion. Can we avoid pushing the start?
diego (sales-eng): Price is signed off for POC. Main technical asks: HSM attestation + data residency note. Notarization is the gating item.
morgan (legal): We shouldn't create a blanket notarization requirement for customers. Two acceptable paths to offer: (1) e-notary via an accepted provider (DocuSign/eID) OR (2) physical notarization where customer supplies a scanned notarization certificate at execution and mails originals within 30 days. Limit the notary requirement to customer exec signature only.
morgan (legal): Also push back on their indemnity expansion and per-subprocessor prior consent ask. Proposed indemnity counter and subprocessor language below.
priya (finance): Our default is net30. If AeroNexus insists on net45 for the POC we need a PO on file and AR sign-off before provisioning. If they can put net30 on the PO, we can provision immediately after execution.
sam (ae): Can legal draft a one-paragraph POC addendum that locks scope/price and links provisioning to either e-notary OR scanned physical notary + PO? That way we can keep timeline visible to procurement.
morgan (legal): Draft addendum suggestion:
```
POC Addendum: Vendor will provision the POC sandbox upon execution of the Order Form and either (a) an electronically notarized signature performed by an industry-standard e-notary service, or (b) delivery of a scanned notarization certificate evidencing a physically notarized signature of Customer's authorized executive, provided that Customer delivers the original notarization certificate to Vendor within thirty (30) days. Provisioning is also contingent on receipt of a Purchase Order referencing the Order Form. The notarization requirement applies only to Customer's signing executive and does not create a precedent for other agreements.
```
diego (sales-eng): For the HSM ask: we can provide an infra attestation letter that describes key management and HSM controls without shipping low-level certificates. That typically satisfies procurement for a sandbox.
morgan (legal): Indemnity counter (short form):
```
4.1 Indemnity: Each party will indemnify the other only to the extent such claim arises from the indemnifying party's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Vendor's aggregate liability is capped at the greater of $1,000,000 or fees paid in the prior 12 months.
```
morgan (legal): Subprocessor counter text:
```
Subprocessors: Vendor may engage subprocessors. Vendor will provide notice of any new subprocessors and Customer will have thirty (30) days from notice to object in writing on reasonable data-protection grounds. If the parties cannot resolve the objection, they will negotiate in good faith; Customer may temporarily suspend transfers to the new subprocessor pending resolution.
```
priya (finance): Note: if PO arrives with net30 referenced to the orderform we can approve provisioning immediately upon signed MSA. If net45 we'll require AR sign-off and hold provisioning until cleared.
sam (ae): I'll send the tracked-change MSA and the POC addendum offering both notarization paths + attestation letter. I'll ask procurement whether scanned certificate + mailed originals is acceptable and request the PO.
diego (sales-eng): I'll DM their counsel to confirm signer name and whether they accept attestation letter in lieu of HSM artifacts.
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope 4b7e created for AeroNexus (MSA_v4_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC_AN.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
morgan (legal): If they push a notary-before-anything stance, push back: scanned certificate + original within 30 days is a reasonable compromise for a POC only. Add a sentence limiting this to the POC Order Form so it doesn't become a company-wide precedent.
sam (ae): AeroNexus replied: "we prefer physical notarization but can send a scanned certificate first; will try to get PO this week." I'll update here when PO or signed envelope arrives.
priya (finance): Acknowledged. Will prioritize AR approval if PO references orderform with net30.
sam (ae): Closing thread for now  will post an update on signing or PO. :thumbsup:
